text:
maria: Heads-up — ap-southeast1 GPU provisioning is intermittently failing. Affected nodes get to PROVISIONING_WAIT and then timeout during attach. I dug into the node logs and see sustained NVMe write spikes coinciding with the janitor scrub starting

ajay: same here, saw attach timeouts for 3 jobs in the last 20m. iostat shows crazy util and avgqu-sz climbs right when scrub kicks in

kevin: any chance scrub is running at full concurrency during our batch window? that would trash queue depth for small-block writes

maria: looks like scrub schedule aligns with batch window due to cron jitter. sample from node gnode-a12 at 19:07:
```
Device            r/s     w/s   rkB/s   wkB/s avgrq-sz avgqu-sz await r_await w_await svctm %util
nvme0n1         1200   48000  96000 1536000   32.1   24.8   18.6   0.3   24.0  0.12  98.3
```

maria: scrub kicks and %util goes >95 for several minutes. batches require low latency attach, so provisioning hangs

ajay: janitor-bot shows concurrent_scrubs=8 for that pool. we should lower it to 2 for scrub-heavy regions or set ionice/blkio throttle

janitor-bot: noticed concurrent_scrubs=8 for pool scratch-ap-southeast1 between 19:05-19:12 (autodetected). Recommended action: reduce concurrency or schedule outside peak window

kevin: we can patch janitor config to add region-aware concurrency + time window. short-term mitigation: drop concurrency and add ionice to scrub service to reduce IO priority.

maria: quick manual to test on one host:
```bash
# stop the scrubper on node, run a lower-prio scrub to validate
sudo systemctl stop nvme-scrub.service
# run scrub at idle priority
sudo ionice -c3 /usr/local/bin/nvme-scrub --pool scratch &
```

ajay: doing that now on gnode-a12. will monitor attach times. note: stopping scrub increases risk of delayed repairs if the drive has background errors — tradeoff acknowledged

infra-oncall: patch idea approved for testing. please post results in 15m. If attaching recovers, we'll roll a temporary throttle and push a janitor config change with canary

maria: after drop to ionice -c3, attach latency improved and %util sat around 40-50%. provisioning succeeded for the 3 pending jobs :thumbsup:

kevin: nice. for the config PR: add region_quota and peak-hours window, default concurrency 2 in ap-southeast. we should also add jitter to cron to avoid herd starts (random delay 0-300s)

ajay: I'll open the PR and include the systemd change to wrap ExecStart with ionice. snippet for systemd:
```ini
ExecStart=/usr/bin/ionice -c3 /usr/local/bin/nvme-scrub --pool=%i
```

maria: also add a metric for scrub-induced io_util so we can alert before it hits attach SLOs. put the alert in per-pool dashboard

janitor-bot: created incident suggestion ticket #INC-7321 (auto) — scrub_concurrency_surge. linked to cluster ap-southeast1

infra-oncall: great triage. action items: ajay = PR for concurrency + cron jitter, kevin = canary plan, maria = dashboard alert. if all green, roll to other regions with less aggressive defaults

maria: will follow up with a postmortem note if this repeats. thanks y'all
